dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the dorsal ridge exhibit thin, jagged, high-intensity silver-white perimeters with sharp transitions to dark low-intensity interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid, high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated in the anterior-dorsal region, displaying minimal internal gradient and sharp edge definitions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-midline macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle, with the longest side oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the torso.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense reticulated lattice pattern is visible on the lower lateral flank where the perimeters of adjacent high-contrast structures fuse into a continuous grid.
